concept.reason: True museum skeleton image and original cranial/dental/limb plates support conservative full model; no extra concept render.

scope: Whole animal: deep barrel torso, prominent curved front incisors and relatively short low-carried head.

scientific_limits.en: Composite living reconstruction. Roth specimens are explicitly Toxodon cf.T.platensis, not one complete associated individual. MACN mounted skeleton photograph has no catalog number or scale and includes restoration; use for broad proportions not exact posture certainty. Upper I2 described as tusklike but poorly preserved, lower incisors partly preserved; exposed tips restored conservatively. No claim that front tusk fullcurvature/length is preserved. Deep torso does not establish semiaquatic ecology. Skin, ears, lip cover, tail and color inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 综合活体复原；Roth标本明确cf.T.platensis且不同个体。MACN展骨无可核编号/比例尺且含补配，仅参考整体比例，不将旧展姿当唯一正确步态。上I2发达似獠牙但保存差，下门齿残缺，外露牙尖保守补全，不能声称长度曲率完整实证。深桶躯干不证明半水生；皮耳唇尾色推定。

taxon: Toxodon; T.platensis-oriented reconstruction using explicitly cf.T.platensis comparative material
classification: Mammalia, Notoungulata, Toxodontidae; not hippopotamus or rodent.

scale.status: Named limb measurements reported2023; wholebody values artistic estimates, not directly measured same individual.

diagnostic_targets: Deep long barrel torso dominates silhouette, not slim horse or spherical ball.
Short neck and broad relatively short low-carried head, no proboscis or rhino horn.
Visible enlarged upper lateral incisors and broad lower incisor row; slight mouth opening allows reading without giant elephant tusks.
Upper I2 tusklike versus lower i3 wider than i1/i2; restorations explicit, no fabricated complete dentition evidence.
Four robust hoofed limbs, moderate hindlimb elevation, three compact weightbearing toes in conservative reconstruction.
Short tapering tail, modest inferred ears/skin; complete animal not jaw-only.
acceptance: Original barrel torso/large curved incisors/short low head combination retained.
Front and side show upper/lower incisors without elephant tusks; infer missing tips conservatively.
Four legs support full torso with clear negative spaces; no water scene asserting unproven aquatic habits.
Separate cf.specimens and restoration estimates clearly labeled.
Four exactGLB views/two isolated rebuilds/independent review.
